records.gloss: For the director. A psalm of David.
pieces: For the music director. A psalm of David.

L.1: For the director. A psalm of David.

R.1: For the leader of the music. A song of David.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, probably the leader of the temple music.

decisions.choice: song
decisions.reason: As in 3:1, Readable says what a psalm is.

records.heading: The king rejoices in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s strength

records.gloss: YHWH, in your strength rejoices [the] king, and in your salvation how greatly he exults!
pieces: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, the king takes delight in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} strength; {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} saving help fills him with overflowing joy!

L.2: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} strength the king rejoices, and in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} salvation how greatly he exults!

R.2: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, the king is happy because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are so strong. He is full of joy because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have rescued him!

decisions.choice: the king: thanksgiving after Psalm 20
decisions.reason: Psalm 20 prays for the king before battle; Psalm 21 thanks the LORD for answering (compare 20:5 and 21:3). "Your strength" here and in verse 14 frames the psalm.

decisions.choice: he exults: the word as read, not as written
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text writes the verb "he exults" in one spelling and its notes say to read another; the meaning is the same. The words follow the form to be read.

decisions.choice: your salvation: the rescue and victory you gave
decisions.reason: The word (yeshu'ah) is the "victory" of 20:6.

records.source: תַּאֲוַ֣ת לִ֭בּוֹ נָתַ֣תָּה לּ֑וֹ וַאֲרֶ֥שֶׁת שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו בַּל־מָנַ֥עְתָּ סֶּֽלָה׃
records.gloss: [The] desire of his heart you have given to him, and [the] request of his lips you have not withheld. Selah.
pieces: What his heart longed for, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have given him; what his lips asked, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have not held back. Selah

L.3: The desire of his heart {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have given him, and the request of his lips {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have not withheld. Selah

R.3: You have given him what he wanted most. When he asked {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for something, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} did not say no. Selah

decisions.choice: the desire of his heart: the prayer of 20:5 answered
decisions.reason: The people prayed, "May he give you according to your heart" (20:5); now it has been done.

decisions.choice: request: what he asked for
decisions.reason: The word ('areshet) is found only here; it is from a root meaning to desire or ask.

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

records.source: כִּֽי־תְ֭קַדְּמֶנּוּ בִּרְכ֣וֹת ט֑וֹב תָּשִׁ֥ית לְ֝רֹאשׁ֗וֹ עֲטֶ֣רֶת פָּֽז׃
records.gloss: For you meet him [with] blessings of good; you set on his head a crown of fine gold.
pieces: Indeed, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} go out to greet him with good gifts and blessings; on his head {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} set a crown of refined gold.

L.4: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} meet him [with] blessings of good; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} set on his head a crown of fine gold.

R.4: You welcomed him with good things and blessed him. You put a crown of pure gold on his head.

decisions.choice: you meet him: you come out to greet him
decisions.reason: The verb (qadam) means to come in front of someone, to meet them; here God goes out to meet the king with gifts, as one greets an honored guest.

decisions.choice: a crown of fine gold: a king's crown
decisions.reason: The crown is the sign of kingship; fine gold (paz) as in 19:11.

records.source: חַיִּ֤ים׀שָׁאַ֣ל מִ֭מְּךָ נָתַ֣תָּה לּ֑וֹ אֹ֥רֶךְ יָ֝מִ֗ים עוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
records.gloss: Life he asked from you; you gave [it] to him, length of days forever and ever.
pieces: He asked for life, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} granted it, days stretching on forever and ever.

L.5: Life he asked of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} gave [it] to him, length of days forever and ever.

R.5: He asked {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to let him live. You gave him a long life that goes on and on.

decisions.choice: length of days forever: a long life and a lasting line
decisions.reason: Length of days is long life (23:6). "Forever" belongs to the language of praying for a king ("may my lord King David live forever", 1 Kings 1:31) and recalls the promise of a lasting throne for David's line (2 Samuel 7:16).

decisions.choice: goes on and on
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the picture of a life without end in plain words (m1).

records.source: גָּד֣וֹלכְּ֭בוֹדוֹ בִּישׁוּעָתֶ֑ךָ ה֥וֹד וְ֝הָדָר תְּשַׁוֶּ֥ה עָלָֽיו׃
records.gloss: Great [is] his glory through your salvation; splendor and majesty you lay upon him.
pieces: Because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} rescued him, his honor stands high; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} lay royal splendor and majesty on him.

L.6: Great [is] his glory through {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} salvation; splendor and majesty {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} lay upon him.

R.6: Because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} helped him win, he is greatly honored. You made him a great and glorious king.

decisions.choice: splendor and majesty: royal glory
decisions.reason: The pair (hod vehadar) describes the majesty of a king, and above all of God (96:6; 104:1); here God shares it with the king he has saved.

decisions.choice: your salvation: the victory you gave
decisions.reason: As in verse 2.

records.source: כִּֽי־תְשִׁיתֵ֣הוּ בְרָכ֣וֹת לָעַ֑ד תְּחַדֵּ֥הוּ בְ֝שִׂמְחָ֗ה אֶת־פָּנֶֽיךָ׃
records.gloss: For you make him blessings forever; you make him glad with joy with your presence.
pieces: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} make him a blessing that never ends; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} fill him with gladness in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} presence.

L.7: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} make him blessings forever; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} make him glad with joy in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} presence.

R.7: You have made him a blessing forever. Being near {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} makes him very happy.

decisions.choice: you make him blessings: a source and example of blessing
decisions.reason: To be made "blessings" is to be so blessed that others see it and are blessed through it, as God promised Abraham (Genesis 12:2). It may also mean simply that God gives him lasting blessings.

decisions.choice: with your presence: before your face
decisions.reason: The king's greatest joy is to be near God (16:11).

records.source: כִּֽי־הַ֭מֶּלֶךְ בֹּטֵ֣חַ בַּיהוָ֑ה וּבְחֶ֥סֶד עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן בַּל־יִמּֽוֹט׃
records.gloss: For the king [is] trusting in YHWH, and in [the] loyal love of [the] Most High he will not be shaken.
pieces: The king relies on {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and because of the loyal love of the Most High, nothing will shake him.

L.8: For the king trusts in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and through the loyal love of the Most High he will not be shaken.

R.8: The king trusts {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. The God who is above all loves him faithfully, so nothing can shake him.

decisions.choice: loyal love: chesed
decisions.reason: Chesed is love that keeps faith with a bond or promise; here God's covenant faithfulness to the king of David's line (2 Samuel 7:15).

decisions.choice: the Most High: God above all
decisions.reason: 'Elyon is a title of God as supreme over every power (7:18; Genesis 14:19).

decisions.choice: the king trusts in the LORD: the center of the psalm
decisions.reason: Here the psalm speaks about God instead of to him: the reason for all that has gone before and all that follows is the king's trust and God's faithful love.

decisions.choice: loves him faithfully
decisions.reason: Readable says "faithful love" for chesed, made a verb here (m1).

records.source: תִּמְצָ֣א יָ֭דְךָ לְכָל־אֹיְבֶ֑יךָ יְ֝מִֽינְךָ תִּמְצָ֥א שֹׂנְאֶֽיךָ׃
records.gloss: Your hand will find all your enemies; your right hand will find those who hate you.
pieces: Your hand will reach all your enemies; your right hand will track down all who hate you.

L.9: Your hand will find all your enemies; your right hand will find those who hate you.

R.9: King, you will catch all your enemies. Your strong hand will find everyone who hates you.

decisions.choice: you: the king
decisions.reason: In verses 9-13 "you" is most likely the king, who will defeat his enemies, since verse 10 speaks of the LORD separately ("the LORD in his anger"), and verse 14 turns to address the LORD again. Others read "you" as the LORD throughout; then the enemies are God's enemies and every "you" refers to God.

decisions.choice: your hand will find: you will reach and seize
decisions.reason: For a hand to find is to reach and lay hold of (Isaiah 10:10); no enemy will escape.

decisions.choice: King,
decisions.reason: Readable names the one addressed (m1).

records.source: תְּשִׁיתֵ֤מוֹ׀כְּתַנּ֥וּר אֵשׁ֮ לְעֵ֪ת פָּ֫נֶ֥יךָ יְ֭הוָה בְּאַפּ֣וֹ יְבַלְּעֵ֑ם וְֽתֹאכְלֵ֥ם אֵֽשׁ׃
records.gloss: You will make them like a furnace of fire at [the] time of your presence; YHWH in his anger will swallow them, and fire will consume them.
pieces: When you come against them, you will make them like a blazing oven; in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will swallow them, and fire will eat them up.

L.10: You will make them like a furnace of fire at the time of your appearing; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} anger will swallow them up, and fire will devour them.

R.10: When you go out to fight, your enemies will burn up as if they were in an oven. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is angry, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will destroy them. Fire will burn them up.

decisions.choice: you: the king
decisions.reason: In verses 9-13 "you" is most likely the king, who will defeat his enemies, since verse 10 speaks of the LORD separately ("the LORD in his anger"), and verse 14 turns to address the LORD again. Others read "you" as the LORD throughout; then the enemies are God's enemies and every "you" refers to God.

decisions.choice: at the time of your presence: when you appear
decisions.reason: Literally "at the time of your face": when the king shows himself, coming against his enemies.

decisions.choice: a furnace of fire: an oven
decisions.reason: The word (tannur) is a clay oven heated with fire inside; the enemies will be burned up as fuel in it.

decisions.choice: when you go out to fight
alternatives: at the time of your presence
decisions.reason: Readable explains the phrase (m2).

records.source: פִּ֭רְיָמוֹ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ תְּאַבֵּ֑ד וְ֝זַרְעָ֗ם מִבְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
records.gloss: Their fruit from [the] earth you will destroy, and their offspring from [the] children of man.
pieces: You will wipe out their offspring from the earth, their line from among all people.

L.11: Their fruit you will destroy from the earth, and their offspring from among the {{gender:children of humankind|sons of men}}.

R.11: You will wipe out their children and grandchildren, so that none of their family is left on earth.

decisions.choice: their fruit: their descendants
decisions.reason: Children are the fruit of the womb (127:3); destroying a family's line was the end of its name.

decisions.choice: children of humankind, with "sons of men" as the alternative
decisions.reason: As in 11:4, the phrase (bene 'adam) means human beings.

records.source: כִּי־נָט֣וּ עָלֶ֣יךָ רָעָ֑ה חָֽשְׁב֥וּ מְ֝זִמָּ֗ה בַּל־יוּכָֽלוּ׃
records.gloss: For they stretched out against you evil; they devised a scheme; they will not prevail.
pieces: Though they aim evil at you and hatch their schemes, they will not get their way.

L.12: For they have stretched out evil against you; they have devised a scheme; they will not succeed.

R.12: They plan to hurt you. They make evil plans. But they will not win.

decisions.choice: stretched out evil: aimed harm, like a net
decisions.reason: To stretch out evil is to spread it like a net or aim it like a weapon.

decisions.choice: for, though
decisions.reason: The opening word gives the reason for their punishment, and also concedes their plotting: though they plot, they will fail.

records.source: כִּ֭י תְּשִׁיתֵ֣מוֹ שֶׁ֑כֶם בְּ֝מֵֽיתָרֶ֗יךָ תְּכוֹנֵ֥ן עַל־פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
records.gloss: For you will make them [a] shoulder; with your bowstrings you will aim at their faces.
pieces: For you will put them to flight; you will set arrows to your bowstring and aim at their faces.

L.13: For you will make them [turn their] shoulder; with your bowstrings you will aim at their faces.

R.13: You will make them turn and run away. You will aim your bow and arrows right at them.

decisions.choice: make them a shoulder: make them turn their backs
decisions.reason: To show the shoulder is to turn and run; compare Exodus 23:27, where God promises to make Israel's enemies turn their backs.

decisions.choice: arrows
decisions.reason: A bowstring is aimed by setting an arrow to it; Balanced and Readable say so.

records.source: ר֣וּמָה יְהוָ֣ה בְּעֻזֶּ֑ךָ נָשִׁ֥ירָה וּֽ֝נְזַמְּרָה גְּבוּרָתֶֽךָ׃
records.gloss: Be exalted, YHWH, in your strength; we will sing and make music [to] your might.
pieces: Rise high in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} strength, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}! We will sing and make music in praise of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} power.

L.14: Be exalted, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} strength; we will sing and make music [to] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} might.

R.14: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, show how great and strong {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are! We will sing songs and praise {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} power.

decisions.choice: be exalted, LORD: the people's closing prayer
decisions.reason: The psalm ends as it began (verse 2), speaking to the LORD about his strength; "we" are the people.

decisions.choice: make music: sing with instruments
decisions.reason: The verb (zamar) is the root of mizmor, "psalm": to sing and play.

decisions.choice: show how great and strong you are
decisions.reason: Readable says what it means for God to be exalted in his strength.
